name: Jumbeaux's Sweets Artisanal Gelato, Ice Cream & Vegan Sorbet (Disney Treasure)
whyItWorks: Zootopia-themed sweet shop on Disney Treasure serving 20+ daily flavors of smooth Italian gelato, ice cream, and dairy-free fruit sorbets.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose dairy-free Mango Sorbet (9/10 flare-safe) or take 1–2 Lactaid pills with Vanilla Bean, Chocolate, Salted Caramel, or Cookies & Cream gelato. Strictly skip Lemon Sorbet (citrus), Pistachio/Praline (nuts), and Raspberry (seeds).
